component.name: DeskCage
component.summary: Run desktop applications in isolated bubblewrap sandboxes
在隔离的 bubblewrap 沙盒中运行桌面应用

description.p: DeskCage manages long-lived bubblewrap sandboxes described by TOML profiles. Each sandbox gets a private session bus; notifications, the tray and MPRIS cross over through bus-bridge.
DeskCage 用 TOML 配置管理长期存活的 bubblewrap 沙盒。每个沙盒拥有独立的 会话总线，通知、托盘和 MPRIS 通过 bus-bridge 有选择地转发。
It ships a command line tool, a daemon with a D-Bus interface, and this Qt front end for editing profiles and following running instances.
项目提供命令行工具、带 D-Bus 接口的守护进程，以及这个用于编辑配置和查看 运行实例的 Qt 界面。
